function.name: VarDateFromDec
function.signature: HRESULT WINAPI VarDateFromDec(const DECIMAL *pdecIn, DATE* pdateOut)
function.header_comment:
/**********************************************************************
 * VarDateFromDec (OLEAUT32.224)
 *
 * Convert a VT_DECIMAL to a VT_DATE.
 *
 * PARAMS
 *  pdecIn   [I] Source
 *  pdateOut [O] Destination
 *
 * RETURNS
 *  S_OK.
 */
